title: game/stations.json
description: The stations (W05): the places a procedure is done at, each with the scene prop it stands on, the NPC who teaches there and its fixtures (the things on the station that a step names: a bowl, a spoon, the oven). A fixture is a noun and an icon, nothing else: it is not an inventory item. Loaded by StationBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

id.description: The station's id; a procedure names it in its station.

prop.description: The scene prop the station stands on (its name in game/scene.json: oven).

npc.description: The NPC who teaches the procedures done here (game/npcs.json).

noun.description: The id of a catalogue noun of game/nouns.json (bowl, spoon, oven).
